title: Soggy Dollar | KEY.co
description_expanded: Spacious and thoughtfully designed, this Frangista Beach retreat offers an exceptional setting for large gatherings and coastal getaways. With ten bedrooms and multiple levels of inviting living space, the home blends comfort, style, and entertainment at every turn. Inside, guests will find a generous dining table that seats 16, two game rooms located on the first and fourth floors, and beautifully appointed king suites alongside fun bunk rooms ideal for groups. The fifth-story observation deck provides a stunning vantage point to watch the sun dip below the horizon, adding a memorable touch to evenings along the Emerald Coast. Outdoor living takes center stage with a private heated pool and spa that create a relaxing oasis after a day by the shore. Just a short walk from the beach, the home also includes complimentary seasonal beach setups with chairs and umbrellas for effortless seaside days. Multiple porch levels offer plenty of space to gather, unwind, and enjoy the coastal breeze, while six adult bikes and a six-passenger golf cart make exploring the surrounding area easy and fun. Combining thoughtful amenities, generous accommodations, and a prime location, this home delivers an elevated beach retreat designed for unforgettable moments together.
